campaigns.label: Day job
campaigns.title: Interactive campaigns for global artists
campaigns.intro: At Glitch I build the games, quizzes and fan hubs that record labels launch releases with. Some I've worked on:

items.format: ReLoad Heardle: a daily game where fans guess the track from short audio snippets, with stats and a countdown to tomorrow's song
A "which hunter are you?" quiz with a streaming connect and a shareable result
Bones: fans upload a photo and get it back as a shareable, album-styled image
#Karolchella: a bilingual hub with a 3D globe, a setlist creator to save and share, and a fan gallery
The Emancipation of Mimi anniversary hub: countdown, fan vote, exclusive remix and pre-save
DO IT: a level-based browser game with a leaderboard and streaming connect
A virtual pet to look after, which unlocks a secret video
A season-long fan hub: sign-in, points and leaderboard, polls, quizzes, events and a social feed

campaigns.allNote: Older campaigns live on Glitch's archive, and some have finished their run.
